people.name: Luis O. Gómez
people.field: Buddhist Studies, Indic Philology, Japanese Language and Literature, Clinical Psychology

relations.subject: Luis O. Gómez
relations.evidence: Gómez received his B.A. degree in 1963 from University of Puerto Rico

relations.subject: Luis O. Gómez
relations.evidence: earned his Ph.D. in Buddhist Studies, Indic Philology, and Japanese Language and Literature from Yale University in 1967.

relations.subject: Luis O. Gómez
relations.role: Charles O. Hucker Professor of Buddhist Studies
relations.evidence: appointed the Charles O. Hucker Professor of Buddhist Studies in 1986.

relations.subject: Luis O. Gómez
relations.role: Arthur F. Thurnau Professor of Asian Languages and Cultures
relations.evidence: In 1997, he became the Arthur F. Thurnau Professor of Asian Languages and Cultures.

relations.subject: Luis O. Gómez
relations.evidence: In 1998, Gómez earned his second Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology from the University of Michigan

relations.subject: Luis O. Gómez
relations.object: Center for Asian and African Studies at El Colegio de México
relations.evidence: In 2007, he moved to Mexico City, where he joined the Center for Asian and African Studies at El Colegio de México as a researcher.
